nodes.title: Prompt — Android coupon app (768 base)
widgets_values: Professional Android mobile app UI design mockup, a single app screen for a coupon rewards and redemption campaign. Material Design 3 style, flat vector interface, built on a strict 8-point grid with a 12-column layout and clear top-to-bottom visual hierarchy. Top app bar with a back chevron, the title text "Coupons" and a filter icon. Full-width hero campaign card in a vivid indigo to violet gradient with a bold white headline "GET 30% OFF", the subtitle "On all orders this week" and a solid white pill-shaped "Redeem now" button. Below it, a row of five rounded category filter chips. Then a vertical list of three white rounded coupon cards on an off-white background, each card split by a dashed perforation line, the left side showing a large discount badge reading "20% OFF" and the right side showing a merchant name, a small grey expiry caption and a thin coral outline "Redeem" button. A persistent bottom navigation bar with four evenly spaced outline icons labelled Home, Coupons, Wallet and Profile. Generous whitespace between elements, consistent 16dp corner radius, subtle soft ambient shadows under each card, a restrained palette of off-white, deep indigo, coral accent and neutral grey, clean geometric sans-serif typography with a consistent type scale, one primary action per section, high contrast accessible readable labels, crisp vector edges, Figma portfolio case study presentation, centered composition on a plain background, no device frame, no hands

nodes.title: Sampler — 30 steps / cfg 4.0 (base model, no LoRA)
TorchCompile — inductor (cache keyed by latent res)

extra.workflow_note:
UI DESIGN FLOW - Qwen-Image 2.1  |  768x768 -> 4x UltraSharp -> 1920x1920

[HOW IT WORKS]
 1. TextEncodeQwenImage21 resolution=768 renders the LATENT at 768x768 (fast iteration).
    768 is a multiple of 32 and inside the node's 32..4096 range, so the square canvas is valid.
 2. KSampler 30 steps / cfg 4.0 / euler / simple = maximum text fidelity for the base model.
    NOTE: no LoRA stack. The Qwen-Image 2.1 viggle-turbo / Fun-Acc LoRAs that used to sit
    between the UNET and the sampler have been removed - they are turbo/distill LoRAs and
    conflict with base-model 30-step sampling. The UNET feeds the KSampler directly.
 3. 4x-UltraSharp upscales to 3072x3072 (best edge + small-text preservation).
 4. "Image Resize (rgthree)" lands it on 1920x1920 = FullHD-class square (2.5x the 768 base).
    Do NOT set 1920x1080: 1080 is not a multiple of 32, so that canvas is invalid here.
    The source is 1:1, so a non-square target would simply be letterboxed, not cropped.

[MODELS]
 unet    qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors
 clip    qwen3.5_9b_qwen_image_2.1_pe_t2i.int8.convrot.safetensors  (device=cpu: 17.5GB encoder)
 vae     qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors
 upscale 4x-UltraSharp.pth

[DESIGN PRINCIPLES BAKED INTO THE EXAMPLE PROMPT]
 8-point grid, 12-column layout; generous whitespace; one primary action per section;
 clear top-to-bottom hierarchy; consistent 16dp corner radius; Material 3 flat vector;
 indigo-to-violet hero card. Negative prompt blocks photograph/3d-render/phone-mockup
 so the output stays a clean flat UI screen.
